name: ghuron-skills
description: Agent skills for Dutch everyday services: Magister (school), OVpay and HTM (public transport), Budget Thuis (energy), Vodafone (mobile), ABN AMRO (bank exports), Albert Heijn (groceries), Epson printer ink and Ecovacs robot vacuums.

plugins.name: magister
plugins.description: Magister school portal: timetable with homework and tests, grades, absences, messages, and reporting a child sick.

plugins.name: ovpay
plugins.description: OVpay (Dutch public transport): cards, balances and trip history with fares, CSV export, correcting missed check-outs, and turning on trip-history protection for a card.

plugins.name: htm
plugins.description: HTM (Den Haag public transport): passes, products, trips, Regio Vrij advice, and renewing a product into the cart.

plugins.name: budgetthuis
plugins.description: Budget Thuis energy (electricity and gas): tariffs, contract, monthly instalment and advice, invoices with PDF download, and hourly, daily or monthly usage with costs.

plugins.name: vodafone
plugins.description: Vodafone Netherlands mobile: subscriptions with contract and PUK, bundles left and usage with costs, invoices with PDF download, per-number breakdown and billed call records, and switching mobile internet off or on per number.

plugins.name: abn-amro
plugins.description: ABN AMRO transaction export (.TAB) to a clean CSV with counterparty, IBAN and description split out.

plugins.name: ah
plugins.description: Albert Heijn: online orders with products and delivery slot, invoice PDFs, in-store receipts (kassabonnen) with Bonus discounts, payments and VAT, and invoices to one CSV per order, line by line.

plugins.name: epson
plugins.description: Ink cartridge levels of an Epson Expression XP-series network printer.

plugins.name: ecovacs
plugins.description: Ecovacs DEEBOT robot vacuum and mop: state, battery, errors, consumables, cleaning history and rooms; start cleaning everywhere or chosen rooms, pause, resume, stop, dock, locate, suction and water level.
